`model-viewer-4.0.0.min.js` is the pinned @google/model-viewer 4.0.0 distribution,
downloaded from https://unpkg.com/@google/model-viewer@4.0.0/dist/model-viewer.min.js.
Upstream: https://github.com/google/model-viewer (Apache-2.0).
The bundle retains its upstream license notices. Hosting it here keeps avatar
preview script loading on the website's own origin.
